reason: A structured test runner that detects common JavaScript and Python test frameworks, executes selected tests, and returns concise failure summaries.

summaries.zh: 自动检测常见 JavaScript 和 Python 测试框架，执行指定测试并返回结构化的通过、失败与错误摘要。
summaries.en: Detects common JavaScript and Python test frameworks, runs selected tests, and returns structured summaries of passes, failures, and errors.

capabilities: Executes test commands through a shell
Reads project configuration and test files for framework detection
Accepts custom commands and test targets
Parses test output into structured failure summaries
Supports timeouts and cancellation of child processes
